facts.text: The hotel is located on the Tautau motu, with views of the shores of Taha'a and the silhouette of Bora Bora.
facts.excerpt: Located on the Tautau motu, our hotel offers breathtaking views of the lush shores of Taha’a and the iconic silhouette of Bora Bora.

facts.text: Le Taha'a was the first Relais & Chateaux establishment in French Polynesia.
facts.excerpt: As the first Relais & Châteaux establishment in French Polynesia

facts.text: Every suite and villa is built with natural materials and has direct access to the lagoon or the beach.
facts.excerpt: with each space crafted using natural materials and offering direct access to the lagoon or the beach

facts.text: Accommodation is in Overwater Suites above the lagoon, Pool Beach Villas, and two Royal Villas.
facts.excerpt: Our Overwater Suites offer a romantic setting above the lagoon's rippling waters; our Pool Beach Villas promise remarkable privacy amid lush nature; and our two Royal Villas represent the ultimate Polynesian escape.

facts.text: All guest rooms have original artworks by Polynesian artists, some specially commissioned.
facts.excerpt: In all our guest rooms, you'll find original artworks by Polynesian artists, with some pieces specially commissioned.

facts.text: Louis Devienne created all the artworks for the Overwater Suites and Beach Villas.
facts.excerpt: Louis Devienne created all the artworks for the Overwater Suites and Beach Villas

facts.text: The Sunset Overwater Suites face due west over the lagoon, the coral reef and the open ocean.
facts.excerpt: Facing due west, these suites overlook the lagoon's calm waters, the coral reef and, beyond, open ocean that leads toward the horizon.

facts.text: The Bora Bora Overwater Suite looks out to the island of Bora Bora and the coral garden.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to breathtaking views of the majestic island of Bora Bora and the coral garden

facts.text: The End of Pontoon Overwater Suite is the most private of the overwater suites, with views of the horizon or the main island of Taha'a.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to panoramic views of the horizon or the main island of Taha’a in this overwater suite – the most private of all.

facts.text: The Pool Beach Villas sit in tropical gardens under coconut trees with direct access to the white-sand beach.
facts.excerpt: Nestled in our tropical gardens, beneath shady coconut trees, this villa have direct access to our white-sand beach.

facts.text: The Royal Beach Villas with Pool have two pools and access to an exclusive well-being area.
facts.excerpt: These generously sized spaces feel completely private, immersed in nature, and benefit from two pools and access to an exclusive well-being area.

facts.text: The resort has three restaurants celebrating local ingredients and the archipelago's culinary culture.
facts.excerpt: We are proud of our islands' culinary culture and strive to celebrate the many ingredients, local species and sheer abundance of our archipelago across our three restaurants.

facts.text: Guests can drift snorkel, letting the incoming tide carry them from the reef at the edge of the islet into the coral garden.
facts.excerpt: The most adventurous guests will try drift snorkeling and let the incoming tide carry them from the small reef at the edge of the islet right to the heart of the coral garden.

facts.text: Taha'a is known as the Vanilla Island; activities include exploring the motus, learning about pearl farming and diving in the coral garden.
facts.excerpt: Taha’a, known as the Vanilla Island, offers a wide range of activities combining culture, nature, and relaxation. Explore the pristine motus, uncover the secrets of pearl farming, and dive into the turquoise waters of the coral garden.

facts.text: The Tavai Spa faces the resort's inner lagoon, where water lilies and lotus flowers float, and centers on Polynesian massage.
facts.excerpt: Facing our inner lagoon, where water lilies and lotus flowers float, the Tāvai Spa invites you to a moment of pure serenity. In this calm and natural setting, Polynesian massage reveals itself as an art de vivre

facts.text: The team organizes weddings, honeymoons and vow renewals blending Polynesian traditions.
facts.excerpt: Whether it’s a wedding, honeymoon, vow renewal, or a romantic moment, our team is here to guide you with care. Blending Polynesian traditions and dreamlike settings

facts.text: The resort offers traditional activities and performances celebrating Polynesian heritage.
facts.excerpt: as well as traditional activities and performances that celebrate our heritage

facts.text: The Taha'a Overwater Suite has views of the island of Taha'a above the lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to stunning views of the lush island of Taha’a offering an authentic Polynesian experience above the lagoon.
